prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a lumbering giant made of packed brown earth and grey boulders, a hunched heavy body, huge arms ending in boulder fists, short thick legs, patches of green moss and dangling roots, glowing amber cracks running through its body, a blank boulder head; drawn compact and a little narrower than the grey box, the arms close to the body with the fists in front of it, centred in its own cell with clear empty space on both sides in every cell. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: a blank boulder head with two glowing amber eye slits, no mouth or skin.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, stepping forward and smashing both boulder fists down onto the ground just in front of its front foot, the elbows bent, the fists well inside the middle cell (not reaching the cell edge), facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, staggering, leaning away from the heroes, both boulder arms pulled in and raised in front of its chest, the elbows bent so both fists stay well inside the right cell, cracks glowing brighter, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and swing the boulder arms with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no cloth, no debris flying, and no smear, motion arc or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a human face, skin, flames, water, a weapon, flying rocks, loose chips, a mound under it.
